scope: fetch_unit as cpu_top instantiates it with ICACHE=1 (PREDICT, AHEAD, TAGE), standalone on the instruction port (L1 cache plan Task 8). Fetch reads rtl/frontend/l1_icache.sv once per line into its line buffer; a redirect looks its target up the next cycle (REDIRECT_CYCLE=1, ruling Q7); an idle line checks the next line with a cache prefetch, whose hit fills the ahead buffer. The bench is the memory target: it scores every delivered lane against an image that changes at each invalidate, as a cleaned store would, and checks the port protocol, busy and fence.i's hold. Directed runs time a redirect to a resident line, a resident straight-line run across eight lines (no gap, one cache read per line) and redirects racing a prefetch.
fence_i: hold_i (registered) keeps a new request from being offered; a request already offered stays offered. invalidate_i clears the cache; the read in flight at that edge installs and answers nothing. The redirect that follows, in the same cycle or later, reads the changed image.
